Welcome to Science College, Kokrajhar
||    

					BTC, Assam, India
Know us at a Glance
Science College, Kokrajhar was established in the year 1995 and situated at Bhatarmari Village of Kokrajhar. The College was affiliated
								under Gauhati University and recognized by University Grants Commission (UGC), New Delhi, Govt of India u/s 2f and 12B of UGC Act 1956.
								No.F. 8-381/2005(PPP-I) Visit www.ugc.ac.in and Provincialized by Govt.of Asaam,was started with 17 Numbers of students in Higher
								Secondary Science section at the temporary venue of Rastrabhasha Vidyapeeth School, Kokrajhar in morning shift.

								On 26th of July 1996,
Mr. Rajendra Kumar Mushahary, the then State Minister WPT & BC, Assam first laid the
									foundation stone of the College Building and came to the existence.
									In the year 1999 Degree (B.Sc.) Courses were started.

									Thanks to the band of dedicated social workers Sri Partha Sarathi Bhattacharjee, Late Phanindra Narayan Ray,
									Sri Rukendra Nath Brahma, Late Kamal Kumar Brahma and Dr. Ramananda Sinha the former Principal of Science College for their relentless
									efforts to build up the College. Dr.Ramananda Sinha was the founder of the College to this locality.

									Since inception the College has grown in leaps and bounds and has created an atmosphere in Science Education.

Principal's Message
Dr.R.Mahato, Principal
I warmly welcome all aspiring learners to join us in this noble journey of discovery and knowledge—a centre of learning committed to academic excellence, character building, and holistic development.
It is a matter of great pride and privilege to lead an institution dedicated to the pursuit of scientific knowledge and academic excellence.
In today’s rapidly changing world, our aim is to prepare students
not only for examinations
, but
for life itself.
We believe that discipline, perseverance, and ethical values are as important as academic achievement.

Experienced Faculty
Our experienced faculties employ the latest teaching-techniques, making extensive use of modern technology. Most are members of professional bodies, and advisors at academic forums.
Popular Courses
You may want to specialize in your field of interest as a bachelor or master’s course. Take a course we are offering and have the opportunity to specialize in a shorter amount of time spending less money.
Guaranteed Career
